answer.reason: Two verses tell what happened to Shammah: he was passed over by Samuel and he went to the battle with Saul.

clauses.english: was passed before Samuel and was not chosen by the LORD
clauses.quote: Neither hath the LORD chosen this.

clauses.english: followed Saul to the battle with his two elder brothers
clauses.quote: went and followed Saul to the battle

doubts: 1KI 1:8 names Shimei, a different man, so it was left out.
2SA 13:3, 2SA 13:32, 2SA 21:21 and 1CH 20:7 spell the name Shimeah or Shimea and tell only of his sons, so they were left out.
